title: Pre-create accepted explicit local Cargo output directories before fingerprint capture
outcome: The launcher pre-creates only its default ignored target directory. An accepted explicit root-local target or intermediate directory that is missing can still be created by Cargo through a random-suffix temporary sibling after fingerprinting, risking a self-inflicted source-change refusal. Extend the existing ignored-output preparation guard within the selected-path policy without adopting or cleaning external caches.
acceptance: Accepted ignored root-local target and intermediate selections that do not yet exist are prepared before fingerprint capture without changing external-directory refusal or cleaning/adopting cache contents.
A deterministic regression distinguishes first-use explicit target/intermediate creation from default-only preparation and preserves the original source-change detection boundary.
